stanza: And as for my inflammatory writ?
Well, I wrote it and I was not inflamed one bit
Advice from the master derailed that disaster;
He said "Hand that pen over to me, poetaster!"
Ululate the lost Great American Novels —
An unlawful lot, left to stutter and freeze, floodlit

q.line: I can't read and don't care and education is awful
stanza: I can't read and don't care and education is awful
Raising heck and writin' checks, it ought to be unlawful
Silk hose and frilly clothes is just a waste of money
Come with me and stay with me and say you'll be my honey
